lines.zh: 我走过的地方，光会退开。
lines.en: Light draws back where I walk.
I don't walk. I'm seen.
This body takes shape slowly.
The air thins around me.
I head where you came from.

lines.zh: 你没听见声音，因为我不出声。
lines.en: You heard nothing. I make no sound.
The grass leans away from me.
My outline keeps changing.
I've moved by the time you turn.
I need no footing.
I stand in the corner.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，这就够了。
lines.en: I do nothing. That's enough.

lines.zh: 这座空殿，我一直坐在里面。
lines.en: I've been sitting in this empty hall all along.

lines.zh: 你听见的那个声音，是我。
lines.en: That sound you heard was me.

lines.zh: 我看着这间屋子里的一切。
lines.en: I watch everything in this room.

lines.zh: 世界在我身边稍微偏了一点。
lines.en: The world tilts slightly near me.
I haven't moved once.
The more you look, the clearer I am.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓在墙上是错的。
lines.en: My outline on the wall is wrong.
This quiet isn't natural.
I've been waiting for this.
The lamp by the door went out.
I know you've been watching.
Now it's my turn to speak.
My voice lags behind my mouth.
This room is growing backwards.
Have you been looking for me?
I arranged all of this.

lines.zh: 你以为是这个世界的错。
lines.en: You thought the world was faulty.
I've watched from the corner all along.
None of this was an accident.

lines.zh: 你走了这么久，就是为了这。
lines.en: You walked this far for this.
Now we can talk properly.
You finally look up at me.
I'm in no hurry. You speak first.
There's no wall between us.
Don't close your eyes.
I see every layer of you.
This wound is nothing.
My shape can be mended.
Your hand found the real me.
The word pain doesn't apply.
I've faded a little.
I'm still in this room.
Your weapon took something.

lines.zh: 你打中的那块已经没有了。
lines.en: The part you hit isn't there anymore.
Those mean nothing to me.
Is that hope you're holding up?
That trinket will not buy the truth.
Put it down and we'll talk.
What did you think that would buy?
I don't eat. I only need you to come.
What's in your hand is going cold.
Bring it closer. Let me look.
That won't save you.
Still trying. How stubborn.

lines.zh: 碰到我，你就碰到边缘了。
lines.en: Touch me and you touch the edge.
You hit air, and also me.

lines.zh: 你走进这个维度，我就现身。
lines.en: Step into this dimension and I appear.
Your hand went through part of me.
Step back. This won't help you.

lines.zh: 你碰到的那块，是真的吗？
lines.en: Is the part you touched real?
Your breath stops for half a beat.
You've gone cold.
I don't push. You move anyway.
I always walk against the wall.

lines.zh: 这种事在这里没有位置。
lines.en: There's no place for that here.

lines.zh: 两个我凑在一起，世界会滑。
lines.en: Two of me together and the world slips.
Don't keep staring.
There's a third inside the wall.
The shadows overlap. It's a mess.
Look, its outline is steadier than mine.
Afterwards, neither of us is less.
Space bends during this.
I can't remember it.
I pick up what you dropped.
It ages in my hand.

lines.zh: 这块木头本来是墙上的。
lines.en: This wood was part of the wall.

lines.zh: 你找不到的东西，都在我这。
lines.en: Everything you lost is with me.

lines.zh: 我拿起来，就没有影子了。
lines.en: I lift it and it casts no shadow.
Things get lighter in my hand.
I collect the traces you leave.

lines.zh: 你插的火把我收起来了。
lines.en: I've taken the torch you placed.
Which one is this? The fourth?
You walked here, so it's over.
You chose this step.
I waited for you to stop.
This dimension begins to close in.

lines.zh: 这里只有一个出口，我站在那。
lines.en: One exit. I'm standing in it.

lines.zh: 你看看四周，还有别的路吗。
lines.en: Look around. Is there another way?
Now we settle it.
Everything you heard was me.
You've been here a long while.
You stepped in; you will not step out.

lines.zh: 你的影子先到了我这里。
lines.en: Your shadow reached me first.
Let's finish this conversation.
Gripping your weapon won't help.
This room is mine.

lines.zh: 你在等我说话，我在等你明白。
lines.en: You wait for me to speak. I wait for you to understand.

lines.zh: 我看着你从很远的地方来。
lines.en: I watched you come from far off.
Now the two worlds line up.
I'm always here.

lines.zh: 你每一扇门后面我都在。
lines.en: I'm behind every door you open.
I don't chase. I wait ahead.

lines.zh: 你走的每一步我都数过。
lines.en: I've counted every step you took.
The shadow is one step ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你回头，那里什么都没有。
lines.en: You look back. Nothing there.
This house grows deeper as you walk.
I'm putting out the lights one by one.
Your breathing echoes inside the walls.

lines.zh: 再往前就是我的地方了。
lines.en: Further on is my place.

lines.zh: 你换了几次方向，都回到这里。
lines.en: You changed course and came back here.

lines.zh: 我不出声，你就找不到我。
lines.en: If I stay silent, you can't find me.
My outline is behind you.
Don't count the rooms. You'll lose track.

lines.zh: 你听见的那个脚步不是我。
lines.en: That footstep you hear isn't mine.

lines.zh: 这里的角落比你以为的多。
lines.en: There are more corners here than you think.

lines.zh: 我看着你把门一扇扇打开。
lines.en: I watch you open door after door.
You're getting closer to the answer.
None of these paths leads out.
I'm where you plan to go.
I only reach out.
A little of you is gone.
The strength isn't in this body.
You can't step back. Space is wrong here.
I borrowed that patch of ground.

lines.zh: 王座下的影子抓住了你。
lines.en: The shadow beneath my throne takes hold of you.
You didn't see me strike.
My fingers pass through your shoulder.
That wasn't a blow. It was an erasure.

lines.zh: 你跌进了不该在的地方。
lines.en: You fell where you shouldn't be.
Is your hand numb?
The wall took part of it.
Look. I haven't moved.

lines.zh: 角落里的空气动了一下。
lines.en: The air in the corner moved.

lines.zh: 我一直在这里，只是现在成形。
lines.en: I was always here. Now I'm shaped.
I'm where the light didn't reach.
I came in with you.

lines.zh: 门后面的黑暗比别处深。
lines.en: The dark behind the door is deeper.

lines.zh: 我先有了轮廓，再有了脸。
lines.en: First an outline. Then a face.

lines.zh: 你的手电只能照到一半。
lines.en: Your light only reaches halfway.
No footprints on the floor.
When I appeared, the clock stopped.
Did you hear the door move itself?

lines.zh: 真相摊开了，轮到我开口。
lines.en: The truth is out — my turn to speak.
I never arrive suddenly.

lines.zh: 你站在我一直在的地方。
lines.en: You're standing where I always stood.
This level is darker than the last.
I called your name, and you turned.
Nobody lives here anymore.
My shadow falls on the door.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，但你没走错。
lines.en: You can't see me, but you're not lost.
Since I came, it's much quieter.

lines.zh: 火让我短暂清楚了一点。
lines.en: Fire made me briefly clearer.

lines.zh: 我没有落地的概念，可还是疼。
lines.en: I have no notion of landing, yet it hurt.
Water sealed me off from the world.
The blast tore a seam here.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉在后面的墙上。
lines.en: The arrow went through me into the wall.
That light can bite me.
I don't eat, so I'm never hungry.

lines.zh: 雷照出了我的整个形状。
lines.en: Lightning showed my whole shape.

lines.zh: 这里就是虚空，我回家了。
lines.en: This is the void. I've come home.
